BioIntroContent.HEADLINE: Write Your Professional Bio
BioIntroContent.SUBHEADLINE: Your bio is the first thing a customer reads about you. Keep it professional, genuine, and focused on your interests and experiences.
BioIntroContent.BIO_PLACEHOLDER: Tell customers about your interests, the activities you enjoy, and what makes you a great companion for public social experiences. For example: your favourite café activities, cultural interests, or city knowledge.
BioIntroContent.BLOCKED_NOTICE: Your bio contains content that does not meet CoBuddy professional standards. Please keep your bio focused on public social activities.

GUIDELINES.text: Focus on your genuine interests and activities you enjoy in public.
Mention specific things you like: art, food, books, city walks, events.
Use a warm, professional tone — as if introducing yourself to a new colleague.
Do not use dating, romantic, or suggestive language.
Do not mention private meetings, hotel visits, or home visits.
Do not include external contact details (WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram).

BackgroundDeclarationContent.HEADLINE: Professional Declaration
BackgroundDeclarationContent.SUBHEADLINE: Please confirm the following statements before continuing your application.

DECLARATIONS.label: All information I provide in this application is accurate and truthful.
I will conduct all sessions exclusively at approved public venues listed by CoBuddy.
I will maintain professional conduct during all sessions and will not engage in romantic, intimate, or inappropriate behaviour.
I will not share personal contact information or engage with customers outside the CoBuddy platform.
I have read and will comply with CoBuddy's safety policies, including the right to end any session that feels unsafe.
I understand that providing false information may result in permanent removal from the platform.

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.body:
Cancellations made within 2 hours of the session start time will incur a ₹150 platform penalty to compensate the customer.

Cancellations made more than 2 hours in advance carry no penalty. Repeated late cancellations may result in account review.

policies.title: Refund Policy
policies.body:
Earnings from completed sessions are transferred to your pending balance and clear within 24–48 hours.

If a customer successfully disputes a session, funds may be temporarily held pending review. CoBuddy's Trust & Safety team will contact you within 48 hours if your earnings are affected.

policies.title: Public Venue Guidelines
policies.body:
All sessions must strictly take place in CoBuddy-approved public venues. Private residences, hotel rooms, or any non-public spaces are strictly prohibited.

Violation of this policy may result in immediate account suspension and forfeiture of pending earnings.

policies.title: Code of Conduct
policies.body:
Companions must maintain professional conduct at all times. Any reports of harassment, misconduct, or policy violations will be reviewed by CoBuddy's Trust & Safety team.

Companions found in violation may face temporary or permanent account suspension.
